integrity: Every finite computation is supported by standalone exact rational and finite-field checker code and determinant residues; the infinite tail is proved using an explicit Legendre inequality and diagonal dominance.
scientific_limitations: Ranks concern exactly one spherical harmonic degree on the radially normalized union of mutually dual icosahedral and dodecahedral directions; not the unnormalized polyhedron, cumulative-degree interpolation, or conditioning. Bounded prior-work review; mathematical independent audit and validation not performed.
title: Exact-degree spherical-harmonic interpolation on the radialized rhombic triacontahedron
